evidence: Carries the Wallet label and modifies wallet transaction accounting in src/wallet/rpc/transactions.cpp and src/wallet/receive.cpp.
rationale: Fixes confusing and incorrect wallet history accounting where mixed-input transactions like CoinJoins or Payjoins 'treats all outputs as sent by the wallet and calculates nonsensical or negative fees'. Reviewers note this is 'a great improvement regarding multi-user transaction accounting', delivering substantial user-facing reliability to wallet accounting.
